layout.purpose: Narrate the matched property/action/result while actual game evidence and controlled animation are visible together. No sequential game-only then explanation-only demonstration of the matched claim.
layout.timing: Natural continuous speech; activate matching left/right guides with the same spoken clause, no forced silent observation.
layout.evidence: Preserve native source speed/aspect/FHD, original watermark/UI; label editorial screen guides versus controlled model values. Stills are explanation evidence, not moving gameplay.
layout.readability: Design both panes at actual1080p and375px mobile with current fixed captions; enlarge/reflow/reveal mathematical steps rather than shrink a full slide into halfwidth.
layout.abstractDetails: Keep the relevant game object/state visible as context where its internal parameters are not observable; exact numeric/matrix/gimbal proof occurs only on the right authored model. No invented game-engine data or unrelated filler.
layout.captions: boxed-white-forest-v1 geometry plus caption-clause-keyword-v1; reserve bottom captions before both panes.
